title: Jasper and Columbia Skywalk Icefield Parkway Private Day Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries

blurb:
[Please Note 5-6 hrs will be in transit]
This full-day journey along the world-famous Icefields Parkway is a breathtaking experience that takes you deep into the heart of the Canadian Rockies.

Travel in comfort through stunning alpine scenery as you explore highlights like the Athabasca Glacier, where you’ll have the opportunity to walk on ancient ice, and the Columbia Icefield Skywalk, a glass platform suspended above a dramatic canyon. You’ll also visit powerful waterfalls like Athabasca Falls and Sunwapta Falls, each framed by rugged mountain backdrops.

Witness the vibrant blues of Peyto Lake and Bow Lake, stop at the foot of the majestic Crowfoot Glacier, and take in panoramic views that you’ll remember for a lifetime.

Whether you’re visiting from afar or exploring your own backyard, this tour offers a once-in-a-lifetime glimpse into the wild beauty of the Canadian Rockies — with carefully timed stops and expert local guidance that make all the difference.
